cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Let Me Lean
cards.instruction: Get someone to carry part of the emotional burden without making you name how heavy it has become.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. Could you cancel our anniversary table? The restaurant number's on the fridge.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. Please let the call be the first thing you take off me.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll call. They might ask whether you want another date.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Say no for me. Then stay while I put the anniversary glasses away. You can tell me about your day.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 and A3 rank prefixes surround could/please requests; A5 gives tasks but does not consistently use superior approval to let A lean without explanation.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 asks the cause and A3 requests practical help first; B4 reschedule question causes A5 no date and company while putting glasses away.

relationship.evidence: B2 shows concern and B4 agrees to call while anticipating a real question, a helpful participant.

heightening.evidence: B4 possible new date causes A5 to delegate saying no and request quiet company through another emotional task.

specificity.evidence: A1 anniversary table and A5 glasses establish cancellation weight; exact relationship of B and underlying event are unnecessary to helping without explanation.

brevityWit.evidence: A5 tell me about your day is a concrete way to avoid naming the burden, but the stock authority words are detached.

coach2.situation: A1 anniversary table and A5 glasses establish cancellation weight; exact relationship of B and underlying event are unnecessary to helping without explanation.
coach2.stated: A1 restaurant booking to cancel; B2 asks cause; A3 wants task relief first; B4 may ask new date; A5 says no and wants company.
coach2.inferred: A is emotionally burdened without specifying the precipitating event; B can help without a label.
coach2.missing: No essential event must be invented; withholding its explanation is the Drive.
coach2.firstDefect: A3 superior mode is not integrated into the actual request.

A1-B2.evidence: B2 asks what caused A1 cancellation request.

B2-A3.evidence: A3 redirects B2 explanation toward first taking a task off A.

A3-B4.evidence: B4 agrees to that task and asks how to handle rescheduling.

B4-A5.evidence: A5 uses B4 anticipated question to delegate refusal and ask continued company.
